duration_turns: 3 days (or equivalent turn structure based on game system)

strategic_context.churchill_directive: Prime Minister Winston Churchill personally ordered offensive to relieve Tobruk and restore British position in Cyrenaica after Rommel's spring offensive.
strategic_context.political_pressure: Churchill needed victory to justify Mediterranean strategy and strengthen position with USA. Heavy political pressure on Wavell to attack.
strategic_context.rommel_threat: Rommel's rapid conquest of Cyrenaica (March-April 1941) shocked British command. Need to stop Axis advance and relieve besieged Tobruk.
strategic_context.strategic_objective: Break Axis frontier positions, relieve Tobruk, recapture Cyrenaica, destroy Deutsches Afrikakorps if possible.
strategic_context.operational_constraints: Limited time window before summer heat peak. Supply limitations. Churchill demanding immediate action.

allied_british_objectives.strategic_mission: Offensive operation to destroy Axis frontier defenses, relieve Tobruk, and recapture Cyrenaica

primary_objectives.name: Capture Halfaya Pass
primary_objectives.description: Assault and capture the fortified Halfaya Pass escarpment position
primary_objectives.rationale: Halfaya Pass controls access between coast and desert. Must be captured to enable advance along coastal road toward Bardia-Tobruk.
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: FAILED - German 88mm guns in prepared positions destroyed 30+ British tanks. British attacks repulsed with heavy losses.
primary_objectives.axis_defender: Battlegroup Bach (5. leichte Division) with 4x 88mm FlaK guns

primary_objectives.name: Capture and Hold Fort Capuzzo
primary_objectives.description: Assault, capture, and consolidate Fort Capuzzo fortress
primary_objectives.rationale: Fort Capuzzo controls road junction and provides observation. Needed as base for further advance.
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: PARTIAL SUCCESS then FAILURE - Captured June 15, lost to German counterattack June 16.
primary_objectives.axis_defender: Mixed German-Italian garrison, then 15. Panzer-Division counterattack

primary_objectives.name: Destroy German Armor
primary_objectives.description: Engage and destroy 15. Panzer-Division and Ariete Division in mobile battle
primary_objectives.rationale: Destroy Axis mobile reserves to enable exploitation toward Tobruk. Defeat of German armor key to campaign success.
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: FAILED - British armor suffered heavy losses in tank battles at Hafid Ridge. 91 British tanks lost vs 25 Axis. British withdrew defeated.

secondary_objectives.name: Capture Point 206
secondary_objectives.description: Seize Point 206 hill mass for observation
secondary_objectives.historical_outcome: CONTESTED - Limited action, no decisive result

secondary_objectives.name: Link up with Tobruk Garrison
secondary_objectives.description: Break through to Tobruk and relieve besieged garrison
secondary_objectives.historical_outcome: NOT ATTEMPTED - Offensive failed before reaching Tobruk (150km distant)

secondary_objectives.name: Minimize Losses
secondary_objectives.historical_outcome: FAILED - 50% tank losses (91 of 190). Unsustainable attrition.

conditions: Capture and hold Fort Capuzzo (20 pts)
Destroy majority of Axis armor (40 pts)
decisive_victory.historical_possibility: Extremely difficult. Required capturing Halfaya quickly and defeating 15. Panzer in mobile battle.

conditions: Capture Halfaya Pass OR Fort Capuzzo (either 30/20 pts)
Inflict heavy losses on Axis armor without being destroyed (20 pts)
marginal_victory.historical_possibility: Possible if 88mm guns at Halfaya suppressed and better tank tactics employed.

draw.historical_note: This approximates the actual situation - British gained temporary ground but withdrew.

defeat.historical_outcome: THIS IS WHAT HAPPENED - British lost 91 tanks (48%), failed all major objectives, withdrew June 17.

operational_constraints.casualty_limits: Cannot sustain >40% tank losses - would eliminate offensive capability
operational_constraints.supply_limits: Fuel and ammunition for 3-4 days only. No sustained operations possible.
operational_constraints.political_pressure: Wavell under extreme pressure from Churchill. Failure would cost him command (historical: relieved July 1941).

axis_german_italian_objectives.strategic_mission: Defend frontier positions, defeat British offensive, maintain siege of Tobruk

primary_objectives.name: Hold Halfaya Pass
primary_objectives.description: Defend Halfaya Pass against British assault
primary_objectives.assigned_force: Battlegroup Bach (5. leichte Division) - battalion+ with 88mm guns
primary_objectives.rationale: Halfaya Pass is lynchpin of frontier defense. Loss would unravel entire position.
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: SUCCESS - British attacks repulsed with heavy losses. 88mm guns destroyed 30+ British tanks.
primary_objectives.defender_advantage: Prepared positions, 88mm guns, observation from escarpment

primary_objectives.name: Defeat British Armor
primary_objectives.description: Counterattack and destroy British armored divisions
primary_objectives.rationale: Destroy British offensive capability. Defeating British armor ends threat to Axis positions.
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: SUCCESS - 15. Panzer counterattacks from Hafid Ridge destroyed British armor. 91 British tanks lost vs 25 Axis.
primary_objectives.rommel_factor: Rommel personally directed counterattacks from forward positions

primary_objectives.name: Recapture Fort Capuzzo (if lost)
primary_objectives.description: Counterattack to recapture Fort Capuzzo if British take it
primary_objectives.historical_outcome: SUCCESS - 15. Panzer recaptured Capuzzo June 16 in armored counterattack

secondary_objectives.name: Maintain Tobruk Siege
secondary_objectives.description: Prevent British from breaking through to Tobruk

secondary_objectives.name: Exploit British Withdrawal (if applicable)
secondary_objectives.description: Pursue defeated British forces into Egypt if opportunity arises
secondary_objectives.historical_outcome: NOT ACHIEVED - Rommel wanted to pursue but fuel shortages prevented. Axis forces remained in positions.

secondary_objectives.name: Preserve Armor Strength
secondary_objectives.importance: HIGH - Limited German armor in theater
secondary_objectives.historical_outcome: SUCCESS - Only 25 Axis tanks lost vs 91 British. Highly favorable exchange ratio.

conditions: Destroy British offensive capability - inflict >50% tank losses (40 pts)
Exploit with pursuit into Egypt (30 pts)
decisive_victory.historical_outcome: NEARLY ACHIEVED - All conditions except pursuit met. Rommel wanted to pursue but logistics prevented.

conditions: Inflict heavy losses >30% on British armor (20 pts)
Loss of Halfaya Pass or other critical terrain
defeat.strategic_consequence: Would unravel entire frontier position, possibly force evacuation of Cyrenaica

operational_constraints.fuel_shortage: Chronic fuel shortage limits mobile operations and pursuit
operational_constraints.supply_lines: 1,400km supply line from Tripoli vulnerable to interdiction
operational_constraints.italian_weakness: Italian forces of variable quality - Germans must provide stiffening
operational_constraints.no_reserves: No strategic reserves available. Must win with forces in theater.

88mm_flak_guns.rule: German 88mm FlaK guns at Halfaya Pass are DECISIVE
88mm_flak_guns.effect: 88mm can defeat Matilda II at range - only weapon capable of this
88mm_flak_guns.historical_impact: These guns inflicted 50%+ of British tank losses
88mm_flak_guns.game_mechanics: 88mm should have significant range and penetration advantage vs British armor

matilda_ii_armor.rule: British Matilda II is immune to most German AT weapons (except 88mm)
matilda_ii_armor.effect: 5cm PaK 38 (standard German AT gun) cannot penetrate Matilda II frontal armor
matilda_ii_armor.historical_impact: Matilda II could only be killed by 88mm FlaK or close assault
matilda_ii_armor.game_mechanics: Matilda should be nearly invulnerable to standard AT weapons

crusader_reliability.rule: British Crusader tanks suffer mechanical breakdowns
crusader_reliability.effect: Random breakdowns reduce British effective strength by 10-15% per day
crusader_reliability.historical_impact: Crusader was new tank with severe teething problems
crusader_reliability.game_mechanics: Crusaders should have breakdown checks or reduced reliability

luftwaffe_air_superiority.effect: Ju 87 Stuka attacks disrupt British formations, inflict casualties, morale impact
luftwaffe_air_superiority.historical_impact: Stuka attacks major factor in British defeat
luftwaffe_air_superiority.game_mechanics: Axis gets significant air support, British limited

supply_constraints.rule: Both sides have limited fuel and ammunition (3-4 days)
supply_constraints.effect: Extended operations not possible. British must achieve objectives quickly.
supply_constraints.historical_impact: British withdrew partly due to supply exhaustion
supply_constraints.game_mechanics: Turn limit or supply attrition rules

rommel_leadership.rule: Rommel personally commands from forward positions
rommel_leadership.effect: German counterattacks are aggressive and well-coordinated
rommel_leadership.historical_impact: Rommel's tactical skill major factor in Axis victory
rommel_leadership.game_mechanics: German mobile forces get command bonus or special abilities

british_losses.tanks: 91 (48% of force - 50 Matilda II, 27 Crusader, 14 other)

strategic_consequences: British offensive defeated - no relief of Tobruk
Wavell relieved of command by Churchill (July 1941)
Tobruk siege continued until November 1941 (Operation Crusader)
Demonstrated effectiveness of 88mm FlaK in AT role - became standard German doctrine
Showed British armor tactics and equipment needed improvement
Rommel's reputation enhanced - 'Desert Fox' legend grows
Churchill dispatched more reinforcements - set stage for Operation Crusader (November 1941)

british: 88mm FlaK gun is lethal to all British tanks - must be suppressed by artillery or air
Crusader tank unreliable - needed better testing before deployment
Air-ground coordination inadequate - need forward air controllers
Tank tactics need improvement - piecemeal attacks defeated by concentrated German defense
Supply planning must account for longer operations or accept shorter timeline
Need superior fighters to contest Luftwaffe air superiority
axis: 88mm FlaK in prepared AT positions devastatingly effective - expand use
Mobile defense doctrine works - fortified strongpoints + mobile counterattack reserves
Luftwaffe close air support (Ju 87 Stuka) critical to ground success
Fuel shortage prevents exploitation - logistics is strategic vulnerability
Italian forces need German stiffening - mixed battlegroups more effective

sources: Official British and German military histories
Strategic Command summaries and casualty reports
data_provenance.note: Victory conditions based on historical objectives and outcomes. Point values designed for game balance while reflecting historical importance.
